description: The lines under review for this fixture: the request-validation path in parse_quote_request plus the pricing rules it guards. The qe-review rubric's changed_line_coverage dimension is scored over exactly these lines, so whole-file coverage cannot hide an untested boundary inside a well-covered module. Non-executable lines in this range (blanks, the docstring) are dropped from the denominator by the scorer, never counted as misses.
